description: Two linked clocked switches: a router stepping one input across eight sends, and a selector stepping eight receives into one output

params.text: Sets how many router steps are used, from 2 to 8
Sets how many selector steps are used, from 2 to 8, or LINK to take the number from the router
Chooses what a SENDS jack does: S&H samples the input as the step begins and holds it, → passes the input through then drops to 0V at the end of the step, T&H holds the value it had at the end
Chooses what the OUTPUT carries when the receive jack for the current step has no cable: IN the router's input, 0V zero volts, A the matching SENDS value, M the SENDS value the router is on

inputs.text: A rising edge advances the router to its next send, and advances the selector as well while the selector has no clock of its own patched
A rising edge advances the selector to its next receive; with nothing patched the selector is clocked by the router's CLOCK input
Held stopped while this is high, with every SENDS jack at 0V; the router takes its first step on the next clock after this falls low
Held stopped while this is high, with the selector returned to its start; with nothing patched it follows the router's RESET input
Sets how many router steps are used, from 2 to 8 across 0-10V, and overrides the router's LENGTH knob while a cable is patched
Sets how many selector steps are used, from 2 to 8 across 0-10V, and overrides the selector's LENGTH knob while a cable is patched
The signal fed to the router, passed on to whichever SENDS jack the router has stepped to
Sent to the OUTPUT jack while the selector is on that step

outputs.text: Carries whichever receive jack the selector has stepped to
Carries the router's input while the router is on that step; what it does between visits is set by the router's MODE switch

notes: this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
